scripts.text:
[Shurank]
Still wondering
what to do with
your future, eh?
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
還在為未來感到迷茫嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
Ah, you've returned. I know I said that I would teach you what I know about the Provoke skill, but...
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
啊，你回來了。
我說過要教你挑釁的用法，不過...

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
Ah, a comrade in arms.
Allow me to introduce myself. I am Shurank Chainlier, a Knight in the service of the Prontera Chivalry.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
啊，一位戰友。
請允許我自我介紹。我是舒蘭克·鏈利爾，普隆德拉騎士團的一名騎士。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
Have you been learning
the art of using Bash? I fervently believe that the Bash skill is the essense of Swordmanship!
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
你在學習使用狂擊的技巧嗎？我堅信狂擊技能是劍術的精髓！

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
Since you've mastered Bash,
I feel that you're ready to learn more about Swordman skills.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
既然你已經掌握了狂擊，我覺得你準備好學習更多劍士技能了。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
I wish for you to find a Knight named ^5D478BDequ'ee^000000 in ^5D478BGeffen^000000. Listen carefully, this is the message
I want you to give him.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
請去找一位名叫^5D478B德奎伊^000000的騎士，他在^5D478B吉芬^000000。
仔細聽，這是要你轉告他的話。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
Ah, you've returned. I've just received a communique from
Dequ'ee. It seems you've been working very hard and that you've made the most of this experience.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
啊，你回來了。
我剛收到德奎伊的信，看來你一直很努力，這趟也收穫不少。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
Ah, you've returned. For a new Swordman, you are doing quite
well. So what is the message
from Dequ'ee?
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
啊，回來了。
剛當上劍士就有這樣的表現，實在不錯。
德奎伊讓你帶了什麼話？

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
So have you been
learning more about
the use of the Provoke skill?
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
那麼，你在學習如何使用挑釁技能嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
So have you
learned how to use
the Endure skill yet?
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
那麼，你學會如何使用霸體技能了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
So how has your
training for the Endure
skill coming along?
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
那麼，你練習霸體技能的進展如何？

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
Greetings, my friend.
There is nothing more
that I can teach you...
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
你好，我的朋友。
我已經沒有什麼可以教你的了...

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
Greetings adventurer.
If you happen to know
any new Swordmen,
please direct them to me.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
你好，冒險者。
若認識剛入門的劍士，請讓他們來找我。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
I hope you've been
training yourself in using
Bash. If you want to grow as a Swordman, you will have great
need to master this skill.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
我希望你一直在練習使用狂擊。
如果你想成為一名優秀的劍士，你必須精通這個技能。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
Ah, you've returned.
So how has your training
in the use of the Provoke
skill been progressing?
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
啊，你回來了。
那麼，你練習使用挑釁技能的進展如何？

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
The time has come
for me to tell you
all I know about
the Endure skill.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
接下來，我要把霸體的使用要領都告訴你。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
From your raiment,
I see that you are
a woman of the sword.
Your eyes tell me that
you've seen many a battle.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
從你的裝束來看，你是一位劍士。
你的眼神告訴我，你經歷過無數戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
From your raiment,
I see that you are
a man of the sword.
Your eyes tell me that
you've seen many a battle.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
從你的裝束來看，你是一位劍士。
你的眼神告訴我，你經歷過無數戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
This will be my
final lecture to you.
Please listen carefully
as I tell you all about
Magnum Break.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
這是我給你上的最後一課。
請認真聽，我要講解怒爆技能。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
If you want to be
able to use the full
power of the Bash skill,
you better have mastered it
if you want me to acknowledge
you as a fellow Swordman.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
要發揮狂擊的全部威力，就得將它練到滿級。
做到這一點，我才會認可你這個劍士同伴。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
You should leave as soon as possible to meet Dequ'ee in Geffen. You do remember where to find him, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
你應該儘快出發去吉芬找德奎伊。你還記得他在哪裡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
If I may be so bold,
I suggest that you follow
the path of strength.
Become... A Swordman.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
容我冒昧地提個建議：走上追求力量的道路，成為...一名劍士。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
If you wish to stake your life on the way of the sword, speak to the Swordman Association representative to the left.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
如果你願意將生命押注在劍道上，請去和左邊的劍士協會代表對話。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
Whatever you do,
I hope that you live out your life without any regrets. And if you do happen to become a Swordman,
come back to me...
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
無論你怎麼選擇，我都希望你的人生不留遺憾。如果你真的成為了劍士，請回來找我...

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
There's nothing that I can actually offer to teach you. But if you know any new Swordmen that show potential, please direct them to me.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
我其實沒有什麼能教給你的。但如果你認識有潛力的新晉劍士，請把他們介紹給我。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
My specialty happens to be teaching the fundamentals of the Swordman job to green recruits that have just made the job change.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
我的專長，就是教導剛轉職的新人，學習劍士的基本功。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
Although it would be great if everyone can wield a sword,
I'm afraid there's nothing I can effectively teach to you. The methods of your job are...
Foreign to me.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
要是人人都會使劍，當然很好，不過我恐怕教不了你什麼。
你這個職業的戰鬥方式...我並不瞭解。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
To improve your skills,
you must explore this vast world and experience all sorts of battle situations. And always commit yourself to your training.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
要精進本領，就得走遍這廣闊的世界，經歷各種戰鬥。
也別忘了時刻勤加鍛鍊。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
Magnum Break, mastered at Skill Level 10, requires ^5D478BLevel 5 Bash^000000. When used, this skill inflicts splash damage to enemies surrounding the caster.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
怒爆最高10級，須先學會^5D478B5級狂擊^000000。
施展時，會對自身周圍的敵人造成範圍傷害。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
Enemies struck by Magnum Break
will be pushed back by a Fire property attack. Afterwards, your weapon will temporarily inflict 20% more damage with Fire property attacks.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
怒爆以火屬性攻擊擊退敵人。
之後一段時間，武器攻擊還會額外附加20%的火屬性傷害。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
Magnum Break is ideal for use
when surrounded by foes, but also keep in mind that it also inflicts a little damage on its caster.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
被敵人包圍時，怒爆很有用。
但別忘了，施展它也會讓自己受到少量傷害。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
I see that you've been training in the use of Magnum Break. Although it is an awesome skill, it's not for every Swordman. Still, there's no harm in learning it.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
看來你一直在練習使用怒爆。雖然這是一個強大的技能，但並非適合所有劍士。不過，學習它並沒有壞處。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
Here is a humble reward for
your great efforts. But do not let your talents allow you to grow arrogant!
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
刻苦訓練，值得嘉獎，收下這份小獎勵吧。
但切記，別仗著天賦就驕傲自大！

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
That is all I have to teach you about Swordman skills. Hopefully, I've been able to clear up anything you haven't understood about your job and skills.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
關於劍士技能，我能教你的就是這些了。希望我已經解答了你對職業和技能的所有疑問。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
As for the matter concerning
that murderer, it's no longer in our hands. At this time, there's nothing that we can effectively
do about it.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
至於那宗兇殺案，已經超出了我們能插手的範圍。
眼下也做不了什麼。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
However, I'd like
to ask that you keep the
information you've learned
to yourself. This matter is considered highly classified...
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
不過，還請你把得知的一切留在心裡。
此事屬於高度機密...

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
In any case, there's no need to worry about it anymore. But if we ever need assistance, I'll remember to ask you for your help.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
無論如何，你不需要再為此擔心了。但如果我們需要幫助，我會記得請求你的援助。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
You've done very well. Continue training and if you reach ^5D478BJob Level 40^000000, you can be promoted to a Knight or a Crusader.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
你做得很好。繼續訓練，如果你達到^5D478B職業等級40^000000，你可以晉升為騎士或十字軍。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
Well...
We Swordmen typically aren't prone to being sentimental, but I'm glad to have met you. Do your best and become a splendid Swordman.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
嗯...我們劍士通常不善於表達情感，但我很高興能遇見你。加油，成為一名出色的劍士吧。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
Before you go, please take this.
I hope that you make good use of it as you train to become stronger and stronger. Good luck out there.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
在你離開之前，請收下這個。
我希望你能好好利用它，在訓練中變得越來越強。祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
For now, I believe you'll benefit from learning some more about Swordman skills. First, let me tell you more about the Sword Masteries.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
接下來，再多瞭解一些劍士技能，對你會有幫助。
先來講講劍術熟練度。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
There are two different kinds:
^5D478BOne Handed Sword Mastery^000000 and
^5D478BTwo Handed Sword Mastery^000000. Both
are Passive Skills that increase your Attack Power as these skills are leveled up.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
分為兩種：
^5D478B單手劍使用熟練度^000000，
以及^5D478B雙手劍使用熟練度^000000。
兩者都是被動技能，等級越高，攻擊力也越高。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
One Handed Sword Mastery
increases the damage of Daggers and One Handed Swords while Two Handed Sword Mastery increases the damage of Two Handed Swords.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
單手劍使用熟練度增加短劍和單手劍的傷害，而雙手劍使用熟練度增加雙手劍的傷害。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
Ah, from the way you handle your Sword, I see that you have mastered a Sword Mastery. I'm thoroughly impressed.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
看你握劍的姿勢，就知道你已經把一項劍術熟練度練到滿級了。
真是出色。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
Let me give you
this small reward
in recognition of
your accomplishment.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
收下這份小獎勵吧，作為你學有所成的證明。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
Next time, I will tell you more about the Magnum Break skill.
I'll be here when you're ready to learn more.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
下次來講怒爆。
準備好繼續學，就來找我。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
From that gleen of toughness upon your skin, I see now that I was foolish to ask. Well done~
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
看你皮膚上泛出的堅韌光澤，就知道剛才是我多問了。
做得好~

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
Ah, once again, I have
another task for you to perform. Please visit Dequ'ee in Geffen since it seems he has something
to ask of you.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
啊，又有件事要託付給你。
請去吉芬找德奎伊，他似乎有事想請你幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
Hurry and meet with Dequ'ee and return to me when you complete whatever it is that he wishes for you to do.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
快去和德奎伊會面，完成他希望你做的事情後回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
Hmm...
You're not quite
there yet. In the
meantime, I encourage
you to double your efforts!
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
嗯，還差一點。
還得加倍努力！

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
I see that you
know how to use the
Endure skill. Still, it wouldn't hurt if I review the basic details regarding its use...
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
看來你已經會用霸體了。
不過，溫習一下基本要領，也沒什麼壞處...

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
As you've noticed, receiving any damage causes you to reel in pain, stunning you for an instant. Thus, rapidly attacking enemies are dangerous since it's difficult to counter or escape them.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
你應該注意到了，受傷時會因疼痛而動作一頓。
所以，碰上攻擊迅速的敵人就很危險，想還擊或逃跑都不容易。

scripts.text:
[Shunrank]
Activating Endure enables you to shrug off attacks. You'll receive damage, but enemy attacks will not impede you as much. This means you can counter enemy attacks or escape if you need to.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
施展霸體後，就能硬扛攻擊。
雖然仍會受傷，但行動不會輕易被打斷。
這樣就能還擊，必要時也能脫身。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
Of course, you can't use Endure forever. However, the more you increase the level of the Endure
skill, the longer Endure's effect will last. Also, remember that Endure also has a skill delay.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
當然，霸體無法一直維持。
技能等級越高，持續時間就越長。
也要記住，這項技能有施放延遲。

scripts.text:
[Shurank]
Since you've learned the Endure skill already, I don't think I need to explain it any further. You've done well.
scripts.translation:
[舒蘭克]
既然你已經學會了霸體技能，我想我不需要再進一步解釋了。你做得很好。

scripts.text:

another task for you to perform. Please visit Dequ'ee in Geffen since it seems he has something
to ask of you.
scripts.translation:

[Shurank]

舒蘭克問的是：“那個殺人犯怎麼樣了？你查出幕後是誰了嗎？如果查出來了，我們現在應該做什麼？”

scripts.text:
[Dequ'ee]
Hmm...
That doesn't seem to
be the message I'm supposed to receive from Shurack. I need his exact message or I can't send
a response...
scripts.translation:
[德奎伊]
嗯...這好像不是舒蘭克的原話。
得把原話一字不差地告訴我，我才能回覆...

scripts.text:
Hmm...?
Do you have any
business with me?
scripts.translation:
嗯...？
你有什麼事找我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Geil]
Were you sent by the authorities? Quit giving me such a hard time! I'm not the murderer! I don't even know who was killed. I'm not the one you're looking for!
scripts.translation:
[蓋爾]
你是官方派來的嗎？別給我找麻煩！我不是兇手！我甚至不知道誰被殺了。你們找錯人了！

scripts.text:
[Geil]
We should all
strive to live in
peace and harmony
with our fellow man.
scripts.translation:
[蓋爾]
我們都應該努力與同胞和平共處，和諧生活。

scripts.text:
[Geil]
Sure, some weird
guy told me some
kind of code related to all this, but that's it! That's all I know! I'm not the killer, I'm not an accessory, nothing!
scripts.translation:
[蓋爾]
對，有個怪人跟我說過一段和這事有關的密碼，可也就這樣了！
我就知道這些！
我不是兇手，也不是幫兇，跟這事毫無關係！

scripts.text:
[Geil]
^5D478BTheisWesomeof^000000
That's the code. I can't believe that I'm unable to forget this.
I mean, I think I was drunk
when that guy told me.
scripts.translation:
[蓋爾]
^5D478BTheisWesomeof^000000
就是這個密碼。
說來也怪，居然一直忘不掉。
那傢伙說的時候，我明明都喝醉了。

scripts.text:
[Geil]
What's so important about this code, and why do you guys keep hounding me about the murder?!
scripts.translation:
[蓋爾]
這個程式碼有什麼重要的？你們為什麼一直糾纏我，問謀殺案的事？！

scripts.text:
[Geil]
But fear, distrust and panic always seem to get in the way and mess up world events. We've got to find it within ourselves to get along with others. Don't you agree?
scripts.translation:
[蓋爾]
但恐懼、不信任和恐慌總是阻礙我們，擾亂世界大事。我們必須學會與他人和睦相處。你同意嗎？

scripts.text:
[Muetro]
^666666*Sigh*^000000
I try and I try, but sometimes ridiculous things happen and
I can't do anything about them.
scripts.translation:
[穆埃特羅]
^666666*嘆氣*^000000
我試了又試，但有時會發生荒唐的事，我對此無能為力。

scripts.text:
[Muetro]
You're just
like all the others.
You want the code
I know, right?
scripts.translation:
[穆埃特羅]
你也跟別人一樣，想要我知道的那段密碼，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Muetro]
^5D478BConBanfoevidehi^000000
Happy now? Now
leave me alone and
catch the murderer.
scripts.translation:
[穆埃特羅]
^5D478BConBanfoevidehi^000000
滿意了吧？現在別煩我了，去抓兇手吧。

scripts.text:

^5D478BConBanfoevidehi^000000

leave me alone and
catch the murderer.
scripts.translation:

^5D478BConBanfoevidehi^000000

scripts.text:
[Muetro]
I suppose it's fate. There's no escaping what I can't possibly
hope to control or understand.
scripts.translation:
[穆埃特羅]
我想這是命運。我無法逃避那些我根本無法控制或理解的事情。

scripts.text:
[Hans]
Help me!
Please help me!
I'm no murderer!
I'm practically
harmless!
scripts.translation:
[漢斯]
幫幫我！
求你救救我！
我沒殺人，根本不會傷害誰！

scripts.text:
[Hans]
I'm sorry...
But I don't think I can be of any help to you. Right now, it seems that I've got problems of my own...
scripts.translation:
[漢斯]
對不起...但我覺得我幫不了你們什麼。現在，我似乎也有自己的麻煩...

scripts.text:
[Hans]
^5D478Bvictkleyundncem^000000
This is code I know.
Some strange person
told it to me earlier and said
that I'd need to know it soon!
scripts.translation:
[漢斯]
^5D478Bvictkleyundncem^000000
我知道的密碼就是這個。
之前有個怪人告訴我，說很快就能派上用場！

scripts.text:
[Hans]
He said that this code
would save my life. First,
I thought he was crazy, but for
some reason I can't forget it.
scripts.translation:
[漢斯]
他說這個程式碼會救我的命。起初，我以為他瘋了，但不知為何我無法忘記它。

scripts.text:
[Hans]
It's like he used magic or something to make it stick out in my brain. Please leave me alone, this is all I know!
scripts.translation:
[漢斯]
就像他用了魔法什麼的，讓它深深印在我的腦海裡。請別煩我了，我只知道這些！

expression on his face.^000000
^3355FFHis body is completely lifeless. There's a long, deep wound in his chest, and a blood drenched knife is clenched in his right hand.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF班克利臉上帶著悽慘的神情。^000000
^3355FF他已經完全沒了氣息。

scripts.text:
^3355FFBankley had a sad, pitiable expression on his face. Since the color is still fresh in his cheeks, he died only a little while ago.
^3355FFThere is a long, deep wound in his chest, and a blood drenched knife is clenched in his right hand.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF班克利的神情悲傷而悽慘。
臉頰尚有血色，看來剛死不久。
^3355FF胸口有道又長又深的傷口，右手緊握著一把染滿鮮血的刀。^000000

scripts.text:
[Bankley]
Even though I can't afford it now, my dream is to travel around the world and visit all of its great cities!
scripts.translation:
[班克利]
雖然我現在負擔不起，但我的夢想是環遊世界，參觀所有偉大的城市！

scripts.text:
[Bankley]
I didn't kill anybody...!
I'm innocent and don't
have anything to hide!
scripts.translation:
[班克利]
我沒有殺任何人...！
我是無辜的，沒有什麼可隱瞞的！

scripts.text:
[Bankley]
But look...
If it helps, let me give you this weird code that some strange guy gave me. I guess it's supposed to be some kind of clue.
scripts.translation:
[班克利]
不過...要是能幫上忙，我就把一個怪人告訴我的奇怪密碼交給你吧。
說不定是條線索。

scripts.text:
[Bankley]
^5D478BhekdlfiDrindkelsd^000000
Do you understand what
it means? I have no idea, but
I told you everything I know!
scripts.translation:
[班克利]
^5D478BhekdlfiDrindkelsd^000000
你明白它的意思嗎？我完全不知道，但我已經告訴了你我所知道的一切！

scripts.text:
[Bankley]
I feel so violated!
Once you prove I'm innocent, are you going to compensate me for
my mental suffering!?
scripts.translation:
[班克利]
真是太欺負人了！
等查清我是無辜的，你們打算賠償我的精神損失嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Bankley]
Stop bothering me
and wasting your time.
You're better off hunting
for the real culprit!
scripts.translation:
[班克利]
別來煩我了，也別浪費你的時間。
你最好去追捕真正的兇手！

come true. But for now, I'll have to live as best as I can.
scripts.translation:

總有一天，我相信我會有機會實現我的夢想。但眼下，我只能盡力過好每一天。
